results.title: The bounty board downloads the entire bounties table on every page view and paginates in memory
results.author: chonilius
results.body_snippet: ## Problem `IssuesPage` calls `fetchBounties(mockBounties, query)` (`cache: "no-store"`), receives every bounty the backend has (the backend's `GET /bounties` is unpaginated), then filters, sorts and slices 10 per page in `applyBountyQuery`. Page 1 of 10 costs the same as page 50: the whole table serialised by the backend, transferred and parsed on every request. Cost grows linearly with platform size. ## Suggested fix Pass `page`/`pageSize`/`sort` to the backend once #63 adds pagination there.

results.title: Chat creation treats string false permission flags as true
results.author: rishibalanagu0108
results.body_snippet: ### What happened `POST /api/chat/sessions` passes `allow_edits` and `allow_commands` directly to `AgentChats.create`, which coerces them with `!!`. Runtime JSON such as `{"allow_commands":"false"}` therefore grants command access instead of disabling it. ### Expected Each supplied permission flag must be a JSON boolean. Malformed values return 400 before the session is created; valid booleans remain unchanged. ### Version Current `main` at `9d1c11e`.

results.title: Check enable endpoint treats string false as enabled
results.author: rishibalanagu0108

Valid `true` and `false` requests remain unchanged. ### Version Current `main` at `9d1c11e`.

results.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
results.author: tine1117
